tools.name: is_valid_ip_address
tools.description: Validates whether a string is a properly formatted IPv4 address with four octets (0-255) separated by dots. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_max_subarray_sum
tools.description: Finds the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray using Kadane's algorithm. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: merge_dictionaries
tools.description: Merges two dictionaries into a single dictionary, with values from the second dictionary overwriting those from the first for duplicate keys. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_kth_smallest
tools.description: Finds the kth smallest number in an unsorted list (1-indexed, where k=1 returns the smallest element). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: count_bits
tools.description: Counts the number of set bits (1's) in the binary representation of a non-negative integer. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: binary_search
tools.description: Performs binary search on a sorted list to find the index of a target value, returning -1 if not found. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: reverse_string
tools.description: Reverses the order of characters in a given string, returning the string backwards. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: min_meeting_rooms
tools.description: Finds the minimum number of meeting rooms required to accommodate all meetings given their time intervals. Uses interval scheduling algorithm. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_next_greater_element
tools.description: For each element in a list, finds the next greater element to its right. Returns -1 if no greater element exists. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: binary_addition
tools.description: Adds two binary numbers represented as strings and returns the sum as a binary string. Performs binary arithmetic with carry propagation. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_palindrome
tools.description: Checks if a string is a valid palindrome, considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring case and spaces. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: sort_numbers
tools.description: Sorts a list of numbers in ascending order using a deterministic sorting algorithm. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_pairs_with_sum
tools.description: Finds all unique pairs of integers in a list that sum to a specified target value. Returns pairs as arrays. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_perfect_square
tools.description: Checks if a number is a perfect square (i.e., the square of an integer). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_n_largest
tools.description: Finds the n largest numbers from a list and returns them in descending order. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_valid_parentheses
tools.description: Checks if a string contains properly balanced and nested parentheses, brackets, and braces. Returns true if every opening symbol has a matching closing symbol in the correct order. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_minimum_rotated_sorted_array
tools.description: Finds the minimum element in a rotated sorted array using binary search. The array was originally sorted in ascending order then rotated at some pivot point. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: flatten_list
tools.description: Flattens a nested list structure into a single-level list by recursively extracting all elements regardless of nesting depth. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_anagram
tools.description: Checks if two words are anagrams by comparing if they contain the same characters with the same frequencies, ignoring case and whitespace. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_first_non_repeating_char
tools.description: Finds the first character in a string that appears only once. Returns null if all characters repeat. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_equilibrium_index
tools.description: Finds the equilibrium index in an array where the sum of elements to the left equals the sum of elements to the right. Returns -1 if no such index exists. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_missing_number
tools.description: Finds the missing number in a sequence of integers from 0 to n where exactly one number is missing. Uses sum formula or XOR method. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_power
tools.description: Checks if a given number is an exact integer power of a specified base. Returns true if num = base^k for some non-negative integer k, false otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_longest_word
tools.description: Finds and returns the longest word in a given text string. If multiple words have the same maximum length, returns the first occurrence. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: can_attend_meetings
tools.description: Determines if a person can attend all meetings given a list of time intervals by checking for overlapping time slots. Returns true if no meetings conflict, false otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_rotation
tools.description: Checks if one string is a rotation of another string by verifying if str1 appears in str2 concatenated with itself. Returns true if str1 is a rotation of str2, false otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_peak_element
tools.description: Finds a peak element in a list where an element is greater than its neighbors. Returns the index of any peak element found. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_duplicate_number
tools.description: Finds the duplicate number in a list of integers where exactly one number appears more than once. Returns the duplicate value. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_sum_of_cubes
tools.description: Checks if a number equals the sum of the cubes of its digits (e.g., 153 = 1³ + 5³ + 3³). Returns true if the condition holds, false otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: validate_sudoku
tools.description: Checks if a 9x9 Sudoku board is valid by verifying that each row, column, and 3x3 sub-grid contains no duplicate digits 1-9. Returns true if valid, false otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: find_majority_element
tools.description: Finds the majority element in a list that appears more than ⌊n/2⌋ times using Boyer-Moore voting algorithm. Returns the majority element if it exists, null otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: merge_sorted_lists
tools.description: Merges two sorted lists into a single sorted list maintaining ascending order. Returns the merged sorted list. (cost: 1 credit)
